name: Yanyan no Gekitou Dousoukai
original_name: やんやんの激闘同窓会
source:
The mascot character of [url=/p1891]Tenshindo[/url], "Yanyan," is back in the lead role, along with the characters of [url=/v8805]Marshall Age[/url], [url=/v6388]Jinn ~Eien no Yuushi~[/url], and [url=/v8699]Goice[/url], who were selected based on questionnaire postcards!
A fierce battle unfolds between more than 20 characters, including nostalgic characters and characters who have never had an H scene!
The girls have received an invitation to participate in the "Fierce Card Game Battle Royal" by the mysterious Y, and are gathering to fight for the title of "The Queen of [url=/p1891]Tenshindo[/url]".
translation:
[url=/p1891]天津堂[/url]的吉祥物角色“Yanyan”再度担纲主角，与根据问卷明信片选出的[url=/v8805]《Marshall Age》[/url]、[url=/v6388]《Jinn～永远的勇士～》[/url]和[url=/v8699]《Goice》[/url]中的角色一同登场！
包括令人怀念的角色，以及从未拥有过H场景的角色在内，二十多位角色将展开激烈交锋！
女孩们收到了神秘人物Y寄来的“激战卡牌大乱斗”邀请函，纷纷集结，为争夺“[url=/p1891]天津堂[/url]女王”的称号而战。
